entries.name: Nikon Nikkor-QD[·C] Auto 15mm F/5.6
entries.source: mir.com.my Nikkor Resources 15mm page; Roland Vink serial list row "C 15/5.6 QD·C Auto ... 321001-322430 ... Jun 1973"
entries.note: lens-db.com dated this 1970, which is earlier than any 15mm f/5.6 prototype (the PD Auto prototype is 1971). Production started June 1973. The slug still carries -1970 and is left alone so the URL survives.
